description.value: Blossom Teas (櫻茶屋) is a Burnaby bubble tea shop specializing in a wide range of handcrafted drinks including milk teas, cheese foam teas, fruit slushes, and bingsu. The shop also offers snack items like wontons, taiyaki, and waffle desserts, making it a solid stop for a sweet mid-ride treat. Online ordering with curbside pickup is available, so cyclists can have drinks ready on arrival.

address.value: 7198 Barnet Rd. Unit 23, Burnaby, BC V5A 1C9
